description: Show your referral summary as a GYOTAK referrer: your referral URL, number of referred orders (paid / unpaid), this month's estimated commission, unpaid balance, payout destination status, and the last 5 paid referred orders (order number, date, subtotal, commission — no buyer details). Only works for the customer of this connection; if you are connected through a personal token URL, omit customerKey.
